Name: Spouses React to Player 'Death' Continuation
Author: disterra
Description:
[size=3]A [b]WIP[/b] continuation of CasualInvidia's wonderful "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7493]Spouses React to Player 'Death'[/url]" content patcher mod (with CI's direct blessing, not to worry!). This initial public release is just an under-the-hood rework. It should behave identically to the end user. Upcoming versions will be worth the download, I promise! The first revision should fix the bugs I introduced (apologies!). If all goes well, for the time being I will be 100% focused on adding the rest of the characters I have promised.

I have received permission to incorporate the characters from Ridgeside Village and the core of East Scarp! And to keep the Stardew Valley Expanded characters!

Just like with the original mod, it modifies the 'death' scenes at the Hospital, Mines, or Island to include your spouse (or ex). [i]You've gained (or lost) a loved one, they should react to you nearly dying, right?[/i]

[b][u]How to Use:[/u][/b] (You can use this with any save, it won't affect your save's data)
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Follow the installation instructions below[/size]
[*][size=3]Play the game as normal (this content will only trigger when you die while married/divorced)[/size]
[*][size=3]Check the "Ex-Involvement" option in the Generic Mod Config Menu if you want to enable content with NPCs you've divorced (and not memory wiped)[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][size=3][u][b]
Installation:
[/b][/u][/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install Stardew Valley[/size]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]found here[/url]﻿ and/or [url=https://smapi.io/]found here[/url]﻿)[/size]
[*][size=3]Install Content Patcher ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]found here[/url]﻿)[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into your StardewValley/Mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game via SMAPI's executable[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy[/size]
[/list][size=3][u][b]
Compatibility:[/b][/u]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Confirmed to work on Stardew Valley 1.6.14, on Windows 10 (Untested on Mac, Linux, or Android)[/size]
[*][size=3]Confirmed to work on singleplayer, should work on multiplayer (investigating handling of each player in a save)[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (5 and counting), East Scarp (3 and counting)[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatible with all custom marriageable characters (until defined, they use generic dialogue (no ex dialogue until explicitly defined))[/size]
[*][size=3][u][b]INCOMPATIBLE[/b][/u] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25265]Lance Expanded[/url] due to both mods also﻿[/size][size=3] editing the player KO scenes
[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Content Details:[/u][/b]
(see CasualInvidia's page for the details, I'll flesh this area out as I add to the mod)
[/size][list]
[*][size=3](as of this writing) Personalized dialogue for all vanilla spouses, five SVE spouses, three ES spouses, Krobus, Wizard, Pam, Willy, and Clint[/size]
[*][size=3]Option to skip all cutscenes (I mean, why? But you do you :) )[/size]
[*][size=3]As the list of spouses and their dialogue grows, they will also be available for the ex-spouse scenes[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u]Source:[/u][/b]
Github page found [url=https://github.com/Torsang/SpousesReactToPlayerDeath/tree/main]here[/url] (this is updated more often than the NexusMods page, check here to see if there's been recent activity)
